'''2005 World Championship Day 2 Reid Smith LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2005-08-27).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35114 Thank Teh Meeker]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922140519/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35114 Internet Archive]</ref>
